content.comment_body: The inverter for the solar panels has an app that shows the real-time power output in Watts. How can I retrieve the instantaneous Watt value displayed by the app to send it to [product_name] [version_no]? What steps should I consider? Has anyone encountered and solved a similar problem?

Hi, Which communication protocol does your solar inverter offer? [product_name] supports S7 or Modbus TCP. If your inverter provides either of these protocols, integration should be straightforward. Otherwise, you will need a protocol converter or another device (such as an IPC or Raspberry Pi) to obtain the data from your inverter and convert it to Modbus or S7 format. Hope this helps.
